params.body:
GLM 5.3 could not be measured as a judge candidate. On the balanced gold-set run of 2026-10-10 every one of its ten batches came back with exactly 8192 output tokens, the default `max_tokens`, and no answer text: the model reasons by default and spent the whole budget thinking. eval-models scored each empty answer as zero compared signals and the run ended with "No signals evaluated", at about $0.44.

A probe on the EU endpoint with a one-line classification:

| reasoning_effort | status | output tokens | answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| default | 200 | 633 | a free-text paragraph inside the JSON |
| none | 400 | | not supported; accepted values are low, high, max |
| low | 200 | 24 | `{"poem": "earned"}` |

## Changes

- `zai-glm-5-3` in the Mistral catalog is sent with `reasoning_effort: 'low'`, the lowest value it accepts.
- `callOpenAICompat` throws "ran out of tokens before answering" when a response has no text and `finish_reason` is `length`, after the usage and cost are logged. Before, such a response returned `''`, which a verdict phase reads as "no verdict" and eval-models as a wrong answer, with nothing pointing at the cause.

## Tests

- `test/mistral-provider.test.mjs`: GLM is sent at low reasoning and its text chunk is read; a cut-off empty answer rejects with the new message and its 8192 output tokens are still in `token_usage`.
- Full suite: 1137 of 1143 pass. The 6 failures are the report-render tests, which need `pdftoppm` and fail the same way on main on this machine.

## After merge

Re-run the judge measurement on the box:

```
node packages/engine/eval-models.mjs classify mistral/zai-glm-5-3 --balanced --n 100 --seed 7
```
params.title: Send GLM 5.3 at low reasoning and say so when a model runs out of tokens before answering
